I can't fix your problem entirely, but maybe I can point you in the right direction.

First, the essential problem seems to be that the buttons' :active state is positioned differently than the regular state. If you click and hold down, you can see where the buttons are moving to.

I'm not sure exactly why this is, but I recommend you use position: absolute on the elements you're trying to move and position: relative on the sidebar. This means the absolutely positioned elements will be "relative" to the sidebar (e.g. left: 0 will be the far left of the sidebar instead of the far left of the container).

Absolutely positioned elements don't push other elements around, so you'll need to add some padding-top to the sidebar, maybe about 70px, to make space for your h1 and submit buttons. You will also want to give the h1 a specific height, say 30px, and then give your buttons top: 30px so they're directly underneath.

Hope this helps and good luck!
